label: late copy-phase steps (last ~3 outputs), token-gated
explanation: Active only in the copy phase (t > L); never on original tokens or <DEL>, and never on the first copy step (recall_idx 0) and almost never on recall_idx 1 (except L=3 where that is the second-to-last output). Mass concentrates on the last few outputs: to_go 0-1 hold ~74% of mass, to_go<=2 with recall_idx>=2 holds ~85%. Rate rises for short sequences (L=3: 23% of steps) and peaks on the very last output of L=9 (32%). Strongest activations are on the final output of L=3 sequences. Within those late steps it fires on only ~1 in 5, with a weak token dependence (higher after prev input b, e, z; inputs m, r, i) that I could not capture cleanly, so precision is low (~0.19). Magnitudes are tiny overall (max 0.025).
